title: Groundwater Management: Combating the Sinking Feeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.23914v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This non-technical survey introduces the topic of groundwater management to the mathematics and statistics communities. We focus on the emerging marketplaces for groundwater pumping rights, outlining probabilistic and statistical approaches to groundwater dynamics and game equilibria that underpin stakeholder decisions. After discussing rationing schemes and regulatory policies we list a range of open problems that are well suited to be tackled by the mathematical sciences researchers.

translated_title: 地下水管理：对抗下沉感
translated_abstract: 这篇非技术性综述向数学和统计学界介绍了地下水管理的主题。我们聚焦于地下水抽取权的新兴市场，概述了支撑利益相关者决策的地下水动力学和博弈均衡的概率与统计方法。在讨论配给方案和监管政策后，我们列举了一系列适合数学科学研究者解决的开问题。
tldr: 本文向数学与统计学家介绍了地下水管理，重点阐述了地下水抽取权市场中的概率统计方法和博弈均衡，并提出了待解决的开问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces groundwater management to mathematicians and statisticians, highlighting probabilistic and statistical approaches and game equilibria in emerging pumping rights markets, and lists open problems for research.
